interruptedFreshAssessment.note: Fresh templates with intermediate aria-label fix still failed label/name matching. One navigation timeout interrupted this diagnostic run; it is not final verification.

labelDiagnostic.resolution: Removed overriding aria-labels, retained aria-hidden decorative text, and added visually-hidden descriptive context. Representative local DOM tests showed no label-content-name-mismatch violation and native ARIA names excluded decorative S/indices.
labelDiagnostic.finalResolution: Natural link names now verified on every final page. Browser name is SecureShop . home; product artwork uses category plus visually hidden View product-name text. Custom aria-label overrides are absent and decorative S/indices stay aria-hidden. Final label-content-name-mismatch violations: 0.

runnerAdjustment.reason: A preliminary final run expected punctuation without accessible-name whitespace. Actual natural brand name is SecureShop . home; changed signature matching to allow whitespace. Preliminary run collected no page states.

limits: Automated axe checks are not full accessibility conformance; incomplete results require manual review. No security scan or intentional-weakness remediation performed.
